title: EvidenceEnvelope
description: Shared base fields for all AEP evidence records — schema_version, trace_id, created_at_ms, and optional signature. Every evidence type $refs this schema for its envelope fields.

trace_id.description: Optional correlation ID linking related evidence records

created_at_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the record was created

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over the evidence record (tamper-evident integrity)

bundle.description: Optional bundled certificate or key material

format.description: Bundle format identifier, e.g. x509-pem, jwk

transparency_log_ref.description: Reference to a transparency log entry for this signature
